notes: Only a low-resolution booklet picture was available, so positions and layers are my best estimate from the images. Treat them as approximate.

Layer fix: p11, p12, p1 and p13 now sit at layer 4. That is the top of p9, p10 and p8, whose bottoms are at layer 3 and which are one plate tall. The wedges p17 and p18 are at layer 5. p7 and p16 are at layer 6.

Connectivity fix: p15 moved to step 2, so it now rests on all six pieces under it (p31, p32, p6, p25, p26, p28). Each hinge leg is also joined to the body in other_joins, so the model is one connected build.
The legs and claws are hinge-plate pairs, so they are null on the grid and recorded as hinge joins. Pairs: p19-p25, p20-p26, p21-p27, p22-p28, p23-p29, p24-p30.
p31 and p32 are the dark grey hinge plates under the body. Together with p6 they support the 4x4 plate p15.
The booklet's inset sub-assembly (red 1x2 p14 onto hinge p24) is counted as steps 8-10. The final main step is step 11.
The levers p2 and p3 are the antennae. p1 is the side-handle plate, placed in the body stack under the red wedges.
The clutch joins of the hinge legs to the body are assumed from the pictures.
